analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 37.2, entering oversold territory after 5 consecutive down days. MACD histogram continues to worsen at -0.3328. ADX at 17.6 indicates no trend formation, while a 1.75x volume surge suggests potential volatility expansion. Current price is 76.1% of 52-week range, down significantly from highs but still 4.14% above the 200-day SMA ($64.36). A Lower High pattern is forming as the 5-day high is lower than the 20-day high, with 5-day and 20-day lows matching. Aligns with the 'risk management' market-wide stance since November 2nd.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($67.02) vs SMA5/20/50 ($69.19/$70.33/$70.09) indicates short- to mid-term trend breakdown.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($69.01)/SMA200 ($64.36) shows mixed long-term trend, above 200-day SMA.
· 52-week position (76.1%) approaching historical low levels.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (46.2→37.2) signals oversold territory with continued downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.2673→-0.3328) shows worsening momentum and sustained downtrend.
· Bollinger Band position near lower band ($67.44) with 8.22% band width suggesting potential volatility expansion.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support at $66.94, based on 20-day low and proximity to lower band.
· Swing resistance at $68.35, with potential for short-term bounce on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day price pattern (Lower High formation, identical lows) maintains bearish trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio of 1.75x increases confidence in current price movement.
· Current phase diagnosed as accumulation zone with continued downtrend, favoring a wait-and-see approach.
